Good news, everyone! I've completed the code review! Oh my, no... OH MY, NO! This authentication module contains so many security disasters, I don't want to live on this planet anymore!

## CRITICAL SECURITY VULNERABILITIES

**XSS Injection (CRITICAL)**
- `LoginForm.tsx:67` - `dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: error }}` renders unsanitized error messages! An attacker sends error HTML, executes arbitrary JavaScript, steals tokens!
- `UserProfile.tsx:183` - Bio field uses `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`! Users can inject scripts into their profiles, compromise anyone viewing them!
- `SignupForm.tsx:127` - Uses `eval()` with user email! Sweet zombie Jesus! This executes arbitrary code! `eval('window.trackSignup("' + formData.email + '")')` - an email like `"); maliciousCode(); ("` runs anything!

**Password Storage (CRITICAL)**
- `LoginForm.tsx:59-60` - Stores plaintext passwords in localStorage! The "Remember Me" feature saves actual passwords! Dooming us all! Use secure cookies with httpOnly flags!

**Token Mishandling (CRITICAL)**
- `AuthModule.tsx:26-28` - Tokens stored in localStorage are vulnerable to XSS. Use httpOnly cookies!
- `AuthModule.tsx:74` - Trusts server redirectUrl without validation! Open redirect vulnerability!
- `SessionManager.tsx:222` - Exposes token in URL query parameters via `sendBeacon`! Logs will capture it!

**Authorization Bypass (CRITICAL)**
- `AdminPanel.tsx:194-200` - Client-side admin check! Anyone can edit localStorage to set `role: 'admin'`! The server must validate permissions!
- `AdminPanel.tsx:208` - No authentication header on delete requests!

**CSRF Vulnerabilities (HIGH)**
- No CSRF tokens anywhere! State-changing operations (login, signup, delete) are vulnerable to cross-site request forgery!

**Input Validation Failures (HIGH)**
- `PasswordReset.tsx:153` - GET request for password reset with email in URL! Sensitive data in server logs!
- `LoginForm.tsx:42-48` - Client-side-only validation! Server must validate too!
- `SignupForm.tsx:107` - Password match only checked client-side!

**Missing Error Handling (MEDIUM)**
- `SignupForm.tsx`, `PasswordReset.tsx`, `UserProfile.tsx` - No try/catch blocks! Unhandled promise rejections expose stack traces!
- `AdminPanel.tsx:209` - Delete fails silently, still removes from UI!

**Accessibility Disasters (MEDIUM)**
- All inputs lack proper labels and aria attributes!
- No keyboard navigation support!
- Error messages not announced to screen readers!

**React Anti-patterns (MEDIUM)**
- `AdminPanel.tsx:199` - `isAdmin` in dependency array causes infinite loop!
- Global mutable `authToken` variable breaks React's paradigm!

## IMMEDIATE ACTIONS REQUIRED

1. Remove ALL `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` and `eval()`
2. Implement httpOnly cookies for tokens
3. Move authorization to server-side
4. Add CSRF protection
5. Sanitize all user inputs
6. Add proper error handling
7. Use POST for password reset with tokens in body

I'm afraid this code wouldn't just fail a security audit - it would actively endanger every user! To shreds, you say?
